connect.title: Connect Git source
connect.intro: Attach a repository to this app without recreating it. Pick a provider repo or paste a public URL, check the build, then link it or deploy right away.
connect.planLoading: Checking this app and the repository...

current.image: This app runs from an image today.
current.upload: This app is served from uploaded files today.
current.none: This app has not been deployed yet.
current.git: This app already has a repository; linking replaces it.

connect.keepsImage: {{image}} keeps serving until the first build succeeds, and stays in deploy history for rollback.
connect.keepsNothingRunning: Nothing is running yet, the first build starts the app.

warning.group_member: This app is part of a group: only this service builds from the repository.
warning.replaces_git_source: The current repository and its webhook secret are replaced.
warning.uploads_stop: Later CLI uploads still work, but the next push replaces them with a build.
warning.never_deployed: There is no running version to fall back on until the first build succeeds.
warning.protected_environment: This app is protected: deploys go through approval, so push to the branch instead of deploying now.

detectError.not_found: The repository or branch was not found. Check the URL and branch, or add a token for a private repo.
detectError.access_denied: The provider refused access. Add a deploy token or install the app on this repository.
detectError.unreadable: The repository could not be read. You can still pick the build by hand.
detectError.ssh_not_detectable: An SSH URL cannot be read before connecting. Connect it with a deploy key, then run detect from the build settings, or pick the build by hand.
detectError.unsupported_host: This host cannot be read before connecting. Pick the build by hand, or connect first and run detect from the build settings.

connect.pickRepoToDetect: Pick a repository to detect the build.
connect.deployHint: Deploy the newest commit now, or keep it linked and deploy on the next push.
connect.deployRunning: Building. The current version serves until the build succeeds.

push.label: Every push
push.description: Deploy on every push to the target branch.

release.label: Tags & releases
release.description: Deploy only on a tag push, or (GitHub only) a published release. Branch pushes never deploy.

connected.webhookNote: The webhook secret was only ever shown once, at connect time. Rotate it below to mint a new one, or disconnect and reconnect to also change the repository or branch.

justConnected.autoRegistered: Git source connected. A push webhook was registered automatically, no manual setup needed.
justConnected.secretOnce: This webhook secret will not be shown again. Paste both values into the repository's webhook settings now.
justConnected.secretHint: Set this as the secret on a GitHub "Push" webhook pointed at the URL above, content type application/json.

edit.connectedTo: Currently connected to {{repo}} @ {{branch}}. Pick a different repository below to re-point it, or leave it as is to only update the build settings.
edit.connectIntro: Connect a repository so a push to its target branch auto-deploys this app.

buildPack.label: Build pack
buildPack.autoDetectDescription: Recommended. Levelrail detects your framework from the repository and builds it automatically, no Dockerfile needed.
buildPack.staticDescription: Served directly by the embedded Caddy ingress, no container.

services.additionalDescription: Also rebuild these sibling services from the same push, for a monorepo with more than one service. Each needs its own already-existing service name and build config. Saving with any row filled in always uses the direct git-source connection, even for a picked provider repo, since automatic webhook registration doesn't support monorepo fan-out yet.
services.mapDescription: Every push fans out into an independent build and deploy per service, the same POST .../deploy-spec fan-out a manual multi-service deploy uses, under one app named {{appName}}. Replaces the single-service build above; each service key becomes its own real service named {{appName}}-[key].
services.duplicate: Another row already uses this service name.
services.checking: Checking against the app spec schema...

network.portHint: The port your app listens on inside its container, e.g. 3000 for a typical Next.js app.
network.domainDescription: Routed once its DNS record points here. A TLS certificate is issued automatically, or add this later from the app's Domains tab.
network.healthHint: Checked before cutting traffic to a new container, and to detect a crashed one afterward. Railpack-detected apps that don't serve this path should turn it off.

sshKey.title: SSH deploy key
sshKey.hint: Add this as a read-only deploy key on the repository host.
sshKey.hostKeyChoice: How to pin the host key
sshKey.tofuWarning: Trusts whatever answers first. Verify the fingerprint shown afterwards.
sshKey.rotateBody: A new key replaces the current one. Add the new public key on the repository host, or fetches will fail.
sshKey.removeBody: Fetches over SSH will fail until a new key is generated.
